items.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
items.content: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
items.contentSnippet: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
items.summary: Perplexity采用GPT-6 Astra模型实现端到端系统操作，包括编写通信内容、修改软件代码及生产系统监控，且相比早期模型大幅降低了人工检查频率。这是AI Agent在生产环境中的典型应用案例。
items.ai_reason: AI Agent在生产系统的实际应用案例，属于核心领域但缺乏技术深度，纯新闻报道性质
